answer: Sybil resistance here rests on one keyed door: every agent identity must be minted inside a hardware enclave that signs a fresh attestation plus a quartz-anchored timestamp, proving real elapsed work, so one operator cannot quietly spin up a thousand wallets from a single machine. Each enclave then posts a bond priced well above the cost of a fake persona, so an attacker wanting ten thousand clones must fund every one at once, and correlation drags the cluster's trust delta toward its nadir before settlement.
